scope: Integrate the frozen empty-block run-skip shader only in native compressed 4096-row continuation prefill. Original prefix, legacy and decode dispatches and imported kernels remain unchanged.
acceptance: Three full FP32 32K/128 C0 passes, strict 287 attention and tail packets per profile, source/input pins. These profiles are perturbed and cannot establish engine speed.
followup: Retain as a correctness-validated candidate only if diagnostic selection passes; otherwise restore the previous runtime and preserve evidence. No further model/timing runs in this step.

diagnostic_selection.criteria: Raw target aggregate ratio, target/control aggregate ratio and median of 140 matched target/control ratios must each be <1. This only selects a candidate for later engine timing, never accepts engine performance.
